description: Figure 8 displays the results of layer-wise quantized pruning on the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model, using SnapKV as the pruning method with a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis represents different layers of the model, categorized as Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis shows the relative change in performance, ranging from -15% to 5%. The plot includes four lines: a yellow line with circular markers for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", a red line with circular markers for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit", a light blue line with circular markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", and a dark blue line with circular markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit". Additionally, a dashed gray line represents the "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit". The performance of the baseline remains relatively stable across all layers, hovering around 0%. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" method shows a slight increase in performance, peaking at approximately 2% for Layer1-4 and ending at around 1% for Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" method shows a slight decrease, starting at about -1% for Layer1-4 and ending at around -2% for Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" method shows a significant drop in performance, starting at about -1% for Layer1-4, reaching a low of approximately -10% for Layer13-20, and then recovering to around -2% for Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" method shows a similar trend, starting at about -1% for Layer1-4, reaching a low of approximately -15% for Layer13-20, and then recovering to around -1% for Layer29-32.
